questions.stem: What's the purpose of your trip?

options.A: I did not do it on purpose.
options.B: I can't afford such an expensive trip.
options.C: I'll give you a free ride.

questions.explain:
purpose: 目的
on purpose: 故意地
relative: 親戚
解析：題意為「你這趟旅行的目的是什麼？」，是海關常見問句。答案選D，回答「我是來探訪親戚的」完全符合情境。干擾選項A利用同字片語 on purpose（故意地）製造字面陷阱；選項B雖出現 trip 但抱怨負擔不起旅費，皆屬答非所問。

questions.stem: Where can I get job information?
questions.explain:
job information: 工作資訊
want ads: 徵人啟事，分類求職廣告
解析：題意問「哪裡可以取得工作資訊？」。want ads 指報章上的徵人啟事欄，能提供職缺訊息，故答案選D。選項 A 郵局、B 火車站、C 夜市雖然都是常見的公共場所，但並非專門獲取招募資訊的管道，屬於情境不合的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Have we met before?

options.C: No, I never went there before.
options.D: Yes, we met them somewhere before.

questions.explain:
meet before: 以前見過面
I don't think so: 我想沒有、我不這麼認為
解析：題目問「我們以前見過面嗎？」，是用來確認彼此是否認識的社交問句。回答否定且客氣時常用「我想沒有」，因此答案選A。干擾項B用未來式答非所問；C扯到去過某地，是字面誘答；D則把受詞換成them（見過他們），代名詞指涉錯誤。

questions.stem: Why the long face?
questions.explain:
long face: 愁眉苦臉
out of work: 失業
解析：Why the long face 意指「為何愁眉苦臉？」，答案選A「我失業了」能合理說明沮喪原因。干擾選項B感到滿意、C感到興奮、D很高興皆代表正面情緒，與題目所問的情境相反。

questions.stem: Why can't I find my uniform?

options.A: It has been sent to the laundry.
options.C: It has been made only recently.
options.D: You may take your leave now.

questions.explain:
uniform: 制服
laundry: 洗衣店；待洗衣物
take leave: 請假；告辭
解析：題目詢問「為什麼我找不到制服？」，A選項說明「衣服被送去洗了」，正面解釋找不到的原因，故答案選A。干擾項B說可穿便服、C說最近剛做好，均未回答原因；D提及休假，則是軍職人員常見的情境陷阱。

questions.stem: Can I get a doggie bag for this?

options.A: Sure, I can walk the dog for you.
options.B: Sure, I can carry the bag for you.
options.C: Sure, I'll pick out a bag for you.
options.D: Sure, I'll wrap it up for you.

questions.explain:
doggie bag: 打包袋、剩菜袋
wrap up: 包裝、打包
pick out: 挑選
解析：題意為「這個我可以打包嗎？」doggie bag 指在餐廳吃不完用來打包剩菜的袋子或盒子，服務生回覆會幫忙打包，故答案選D。選項A的遛狗（dog）以及選項B、C的拿提袋、選袋子（bag），皆為利用字面意思設計的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Was your father in the armed forces?

options.A: Yes, he just retired from teaching.
options.B: No, he never forced me into doing anything.
options.D: No, he is not a vegetarian.

questions.explain:
armed forces: 軍隊
veteran: 退伍軍人
vegetarian: 素食者
解析：題意為「你父親以前在軍隊服役嗎？」armed forces 指軍隊，veteran 為退伍軍人，前後語意相符，故答案選C。干擾項B用 force（強迫）製造字面陷阱；D則是用發音相近的 vegetarian（素食者）混淆聽力。

questions.stem: Why is that watch so expensive?
questions.explain:
name brand: 名牌、知名品牌
fake: 仿冒品、假貨
mass-produced: 大量生產的
解析：題意問「為什麼那隻手錶那麼貴？」答案選A。因為名牌通常價格昂貴，因果邏輯正確。選項B仿冒品、C大量生產、D設計不良，這三者通常都會讓商品變便宜或缺乏價值，與題幹的expensive邏輯相反，屬於語意干擾。

questions.stem: Did you hit the target?

options.B: Yes, I already hit the road.
options.D: Yes, I hit on an idea.

questions.explain:
hit the target: 擊中目標
miss: 未擊中
hit the road: 出發上路
解析：題意為「你有打中目標嗎？」。答案選A，miss（未擊中）為 hit 的反向對應詞，符合射擊語境。干擾選項B的 hit the road（出發上路）與D的 hit on an idea（突然想到點子）皆為動詞 hit 的片語陷阱；C的 ticket（票）則是 target 的語音干擾，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Is Tom a bright student?

options.A: No, he has no right to do so.
options.C: No, he has not signed up.
options.D: Yes, he always wears a sunny smile.

questions.explain:
bright: 聰穎的、聰明的
smart: 聰明的、機敏的
解析：題意詢問「湯姆是個聰明的學生嗎？」。形容詞 bright 在此指頭腦靈敏、聰明，與 smart 同義，故答案選B。選項A利用 right 與 bright 押韻設下聽力陷阱；選項D則混淆為陽光開朗的字面引申義，皆非正解。

questions.stem: Have you ever made breakfast yourself?

options.A: Yes, I skip breakfast every morning.
options.C: Yes, I like the breakfast you made.

questions.explain:
make breakfast: 做早餐
skip breakfast: 略過早餐
bad cook: 廚藝不佳的人
解析：題意為「你曾自己做過早餐嗎？」，答案選B，回答「沒有，我廚藝很差」符合邏輯。干擾項部分，A說Yes卻接每天不吃早餐，語意矛盾；C誤聽成「你做的早餐」導致主客體顛倒；D回答「沒去過那裡」，把做早餐當成地點，文不對題。

questions.stem: How long do you plan to stay?

options.A: It's two hours' drive from here.
options.C: It's the best hotel around here.

questions.explain:
How long: 多久（詢問時間）
plan to: 計畫、打算
in length: 長度（實體長度）
解析：題目問「你打算停留多久？」，How long 詢問時間長度，故答案選D（約兩週）。選項A回答的是車程距離；選項B是用 length 設下的實體長度陷阱；選項C則是答非所問地推薦飯店。

questions.stem: Does the tie go with my suit?

options.A: The game ended with a tie.
options.B: The tie is made of silk.

questions.explain:
go with: 與...相配
match: 相稱、相配
解析：題意問「這條領帶和我的西裝配嗎？」。片語 go with 表相配，與 match 同義，故答案選C。A選項的 tie 為「平手」之一字多義陷阱；D選項以行李箱 suitcase 混淆西裝 suit。

questions.stem: Will you take their offer?

options.B: I won't take orders from anyone.

questions.explain:
take an offer: 接受提議
take care of: 處理、照顧
take orders: 聽從命令
解析：題目詢問「你會接受他們的提議嗎？」，回答「我會考慮看看」符合對話邏輯，答案選C。選項A與B利用相同動詞take搭配成「處理」與「服從命令」等片語，屬於字面干擾陷阱；選項D表示絕不輕易放棄，皆與提問內容無關。

questions.stem: What shall I wear today?

options.A: How about a pair of jeans and a shirt?
options.B: You need to wait until I'm back.
options.C: How about you go with me?
options.D: You need to give me a good excuse.

questions.explain:
wear: 穿著
How about: ...如何（提出建議）
a pair of jeans: 一件牛仔褲
解析：題目詢問「我今天該穿什麼？」，是在徵求服裝搭配的建議。選項 A 提出「穿牛仔褲配襯衫如何？」，直接回應問題，故答案選A。選項 B 要求對方等待、C 是邀約一同前往、D 則是要求給個藉口，皆與穿搭話題無關，屬於答非所問的干擾選項。

questions.stem: What kind of music do you like best?
questions.explain:
kind of: 種類
rap: 饒舌音樂
literature: 文學
解析：題目問「你最喜歡哪種音樂？」，詢問音樂類型，只有rap符合，故答案選C。干擾選項中，A麵條與B雞尾酒屬於飲食類，D文學則屬於人文領域，皆非音樂類型。

questions.stem: How do you reduce carbon emissions?
questions.explain:
reduce: 減少
carbon emissions: 碳排放
public transportation: 大眾運輸
解析：題意為「你如何減少碳排放？」搭乘大眾運輸能節能減碳，因此答案選D。主要干擾選項A是利用與emissions發音字形相近的missions（任務）設下聽力陷阱；選項B開車反而會增加碳排，邏輯相反；選項C則與減碳無關。

questions.stem: Do you play any sports on weekends?
questions.explain:
sports: 運動
on weekends: 在週末
play tennis: 打網球
解析：題目詢問週末是否從事任何「運動」，tennis（網球）屬於運動項目，因此答案選B。干擾項利用動詞 play 的不同搭配設下字面陷阱：A 是拉小提琴（樂器）、C 是打牌（益智娛樂）、D 是陪小孩玩耍，三者皆非 sports（體育運動）。

questions.stem: Where is the nearest hospital?

options.A: There is one just around the corner.
options.B: It is open around the clock.
options.C: There is a convenience store nearby.
options.D: It is the most advanced hospital.

questions.explain:
nearest: 最近的
around the corner: 在轉角處、很近
around the clock: 二十四小時不打烊
解析：題意詢問「最近的醫院在哪裡？」答案選A，around the corner 表示就在轉角處，正確回答地點。B 選項利用相似片語 around the clock（全天候）混淆；C 答非所問提到便利商店；D 形容醫院設備先進，皆未回答位置。

questions.stem: Did you feed the pets?

options.A: No, I did not feel nervous.
options.B: Yes, I already gave them food.
options.C: No, I don't want to take any bets.

questions.explain:
feed: 餵食
pet: 寵物
give food: 給予食物
解析：題意為「你餵寵物了嗎？」。feed the pets 意思等同 gave them food，因此答案選B。干擾選項A與D使用發音相近的 feel 混淆 feed；選項C則用押韻字 bets 混淆 pets，皆屬聽力語音陷阱。

questions.stem: Do you have an airport shuttle service?

options.A: Yes, we have the best room service.
options.B: No, we don't offer catering service.
options.C: Yes, there's a free bus leaving on the hour.
options.D: No, there's no such thing as a free lunch.

questions.explain:
shuttle service: 接駁車服務
on the hour: 整點
catering service: 外燴餐飲服務
解析：題意為「請問你們有機場接駁車服務嗎？」問的是交通。選項C表示每逢整點有免費巴士，符合詢問情境，故答案選C。干擾項A的客房服務與B的外燴服務，皆是利用同字尾service設計的字面陷阱；選項D天下沒有白吃的午餐則是無關的諺語。

questions.stem: Would you mind taking a picture for us?
questions.explain:
Would you mind: 你介意…嗎
take a picture: 拍照
Not at all: 一點也不
解析：Would you mind 用於禮貌請求，回答 No 表示不介意、樂意幫忙，故答案選B。干擾項 A 回答 Yes 代表介意卻接 please do，邏輯矛盾；C 與 D 則與拍照請求的情境無關。

questions.stem: Are you on a diet?

options.B: No, I'm not going to dive.
options.C: Yes, I need to lose weight.
options.D: No, I don't want to die.

questions.explain:
on a diet: 節食、控制飲食
lose weight: 減輕體重
in debt: 負債
解析：題目問「你在節食嗎？」，回答「是的，我需要減重」語意最相符，答案選C。選項A的debt（負債）、B的dive（潛水）與D的die（死亡），都是利用與diet發音相近所設計的聽力干擾陷阱，與題意完全無關。

questions.stem: Jack is a good swimmer, isn't he?

options.A: Of course. He is a lifeguard.
options.B: No, he won't go swimming with us.
options.C: Of course. He is a firefighter.
options.D: No, he isn't a good mixer.

questions.explain:
lifeguard: 救生員
firefighter: 消防隊員
good mixer: 善於社交的人
解析：題目以附加問句確認「傑克很會游泳，對吧？」。救生員必定精通水性，邏輯完全相符，故答案選A。選項C消防隊員與游泳技能無關；選項B回答去不去游泳是答非所問；選項D的mixer是指社交能力，屬於字意干擾。

questions.stem: Who is your new platoon leader?
questions.explain:
platoon leader: 排長
Lieutenant: 尉官
Major: 少校
解析：題目詢問「誰是你的新排長？」。軍中排長通常由尉官擔任，因此答案選B。選項A的Major為少校，階級過高不合常理；選項C教授與選項D醫生皆非軍職階級，屬於民間職稱的干擾選項。

questions.stem: This is a non-smoking area.

options.A: You are permitted to smoke in here.
options.B: You are not allowed to smoke in here.
options.C: You are permitted to swim around the area.
options.D: You are not allowed to swim around the area.

questions.explain:
non-smoking area: 禁菸區
be allowed to: 被允許
be permitted to: 被許可
解析：題意為「這裡是禁菸區」，因此不准在此抽菸，答案選B。選項A意思相反，表示准許抽菸；選項C與D則是利用發音與smoke相近的swim（游泳）製造聽覺陷阱，偏離題意。

questions.stem: I'm going to hang up.

options.A: I'm going to put the phone down.
options.B: I'm going to get a promotion.
options.C: I'm going to put my hand up.
options.D: I'm going to get up from bed.

questions.explain:
hang up: 掛斷電話
put the phone down: 掛上電話
解析：題意為「我要掛斷電話了」。hang up 為常見片語，指掛斷電話，與 put the phone down 語意相符，故答案選A。選項C利用 hang 與 hand 的發音相近作為聽力干擾陷阱；選項B晉升及選項D起床皆與通話無關。

questions.stem: They stayed at a luxurious hotel.

options.A: They stayed at an expensive hotel.
options.B: They stayed at a remote hotel.
options.C: They stayed at an ordinary hotel.
options.D: They stayed at a cheap hotel.

questions.explain:
luxurious: 奢華的、豪華的
expensive: 昂貴的
remote: 偏遠的
ordinary: 平常的、普通的
解析：題意為「他們住在一間豪華飯店」。luxurious 表示奢華高檔，通常花費甚鉅，與 expensive 意思最接近，故答案選A。干擾項 B 的 remote 指偏僻；C 的 ordinary 與 D 的 cheap 則是 luxurious 的反義詞陷阱，均不符題意。

questions.stem: The visibility was very bad this morning.
questions.explain:
visibility: 能見度
foggy: 起霧的、多霧的
解析：題意指「今天早上的能見度很差」。起霧最常直接造成視線不良與能見度低，故答案選B。選項C多雲與D風大不必然導致能見度差；A下雪雖可能影響視線，但軍事測驗中 bad visibility 幾乎固定與起霧互相呼應，其他均為天氣字彙的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: The audience gave Dr. Johnson a big hand.

options.A: They did him a big favor.
options.B: They gave him a big present.
options.C: They threatened to hit him with their fists.

questions.explain:
audience: 觀眾、聽眾
give someone a big hand: 熱烈鼓掌
applaud: 鼓掌、喝采
解析：題意為聽眾給約翰遜博士熱烈的掌聲。片語 give someone a big hand 表「熱烈鼓掌」，故答案選D。選項A幫忙、B送大禮與C揮拳威脅，皆是把 hand 依字面意思誤導的干擾選項。

questions.stem: We may have to let a few workers go.

options.A: We may have to hire a few more workers.
options.B: We may have to lay off some workers.
options.C: We may have to educate a few workers.
options.D: We may have to reward some good workers.

questions.explain:
let someone go: 解僱、裁員
lay off: 解雇、裁減員工
解析：題幹中「let someone go」是委婉表達「解僱」，與「lay off」同義，故答案選B。選項A的 hire（雇用）意思恰好相反，為常見的反義字干擾；選項C（教育）與D（獎勵）則偏離句意。

questions.stem: I think you need a physical checkup.

options.A: I think you need to have an operation.
options.B: I think you need to study physics.
options.C: I think you need a long vacation.
options.D: I think you need a medical examination.

questions.explain:
physical checkup: 健康檢查
medical examination: 醫療檢查、健康檢查
operation: 手術
解析：題意為「我認為你需要做健康檢查」。physical checkup 與 medical examination 為同義詞替換，故答案選D。選項A的 operation 是動手術，語意過重；選項B利用 physics（物理學）與 physical 發音與字形相近來做干擾；選項C為休長假，與題意完全無關。

questions.stem: My passport expired last month.

options.A: My passport is no longer valid.
options.B: My passport was renewed last month.
options.D: My passport was revoked last month.

questions.explain:
expire: 到期、過期
valid: 有效的
revoke: 撤銷、廢止
解析：題意為「我的護照上個月過期了」。expire 表期限屆滿，等同於 no longer valid（不再有效），故答案選A。干擾項B的 renew 為換發；C表示仍有效，語意相反；D的 revoked 是被主管機關主動撤銷，非自然過期，為語意陷阱。

questions.stem: Your cellphone is low on battery.

options.A: You need to recharge the battery.
options.B: You need to lower the price.
options.C: You need to buy some more butter.
options.D: You need to keep a low profile.

questions.explain:
low on battery: 電量不足
recharge: 重新充電
解析：題意指「手機快沒電了」。答案選A，電量不足需要充電（recharge）。選項B與D是用low和lower的延伸詞義混淆；C則是利用butter與battery發音相近的聽覺干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: The toilet is still clogged.

options.A: The toilet is still in good condition.
options.C: The toilet is as good as new.

questions.explain:
clogged: 阻塞的、塞住的
flush: 沖水
in good condition: 狀況良好
解析：題意為「馬桶仍然塞住了」。clogged 代表堵塞，馬桶塞住即代表目前無法正常沖水，故答案選D。選項A狀況良好與選項C跟新的一樣，皆與塞住的語意完全相反；選項B表示無法修理，屬於過度推論的極端選項，故不選。

questions.stem: General Mailer is coming to review the troops.

options.A: He is coming to chair a staff meeting.
options.B: He is coming to inspect the soldiers.
options.C: He is coming to write a book review.
options.D: He is coming to dine with the soldiers.

questions.explain:
review: 檢閱、校閱
troops: 軍隊、部隊
inspect: 視察、檢查
解析：題意為梅勒將軍要來檢閱部隊。review the troops 在軍事用語中為校閱部隊，與 inspect the soldiers（視察士兵）同義，故答案選B。選項C利用 review 另一常見字義「書評」設下字面陷阱；A為主持會議、D為用餐，皆不符句意。

questions.stem: Our boss is a man of his word.

options.A: Our boss has seen much of the world.
options.B: Our boss is a man of iron will.
options.C: Our boss has never broken his promises.
options.D: Our boss is a man of few words.

questions.explain:
a man of one's word: 守信用的人
break a promise: 食言、違背承諾
解析：題目指「我們老闆是個說話算話的人」。「a man of his word」表示講信用，與C「從未違背諾言」語意相同，故答案選C。選項A用world與word發音相近作干擾；B意志堅強、D沉默寡言則屬結構相似的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: I slept like a log last night.

options.A: I woke up several times last night.
options.B: I did not sleep a wink last night.
options.C: I had a sound sleep last night.
options.D: I had a nightmare last night.

questions.explain:
sleep like a log: 熟睡、睡得很沉
sound sleep: 酣睡、安穩的睡眠
not sleep a wink: 徹夜未眠、沒闔眼
解析：題幹 sleep like a log 是常用片語，形容睡得極沉，與 sound sleep（熟睡）意思完全相同，故答案選C。干擾選項A醒來多次、B完全沒睡皆為反義陷阱；D做噩夢則偏離題意。

questions.stem: It is a dry run.

options.D: The drought is getting more serious.

questions.explain:
dry run: 預演、排練
practice: 練習、演練
drought: 乾旱
解析：題幹 dry run 是軍事與日常常見片語，意思是「預演」或「試跑」，等同 practice，因此答案選A。選項 B（河流乾涸）、C（乾季）與 D（乾旱）皆為字面陷阱，故意利用 dry 的「乾燥」字面意思來混淆考生，與演練無關。

questions.stem: Larry always looks so sloppy.
questions.explain:
sloppy: 邋遢的、不整齊的
untidy: 不整齊的、凌亂的
energetic: 精力充沛的
解析：題意為 Larry 看起來總是很邋遢。sloppy 意為邋遢不整，與 untidy 同義，因此答案選A。選項B（精力充沛）、C（驕傲）、D（自信）皆為正向形容詞，與題意無關，屬於常見的詞義混淆干擾。

questions.stem: Cindy bought the scarf at half the original price.

options.B: They scarf was made by her half sister.

questions.explain:
original price: 原價
half: 一半
discount: 折扣
解析：題意為辛蒂以原價的一半買下圍巾。「half the original price」即半價，也就是打五折，故答案選C。選項A的折數不對；B利用相同的字half製造字面陷阱（half sister意為同父異母或同母異父姊妹）；D指免費贈品，皆與題意不符。

questions.stem: The two men are similar in appearance.

options.A: They tend to appear at the same time.
options.C: They are birds of a feather.
options.D: They look a bit like each other.

questions.explain:
similar: 相似的
appearance: 外貌、外表
look like: 看起來像
解析：題意為「這兩名男子外表相似」。look like each other 表示外貌相像，故答案選D。選項A用同源動詞 appear（出現）製造字面干擾；B指嗜好相同；C為成語「物以類聚」，指性格理念相近而非長相，皆非正確解釋。

questions.stem: I want you to report to me right away.

options.A: I want you to write a report later.
options.B: I want you to give us a briefing later.
options.C: You must come back to see me immediately.
options.D: You must hold a press conference immediately.

questions.explain:
report to: 向...報到
right away: 立刻
解析：題意為「我要你立刻向我報到」。軍中常以 report to 表親自見長官，搭配 right away（立刻，同 immediately），故答案選C。選項A落入 report「寫報告」的字面陷阱且時間相反（later）；選項B與D過度引申為簡報或記者會，皆非題意。

questions.stem: We called off the picnic on account of the rain.

options.A: We went picnicking in spite of the rain.
options.B: We enjoyed the picnic in the rain.
options.C: We delayed the picnic due to the rain.
options.D: We cancelled the picnic because of the rain.

questions.explain:
call off: 取消
on account of: 因為、由於
delay: 延期
解析：原句意為「因為下雨，我們取消了野餐」。「call off」同義於「cancel」（取消），「on account of」等於「because of」，故答案選D。選項C的 delayed 為「延期」（put off），為常見混淆字；選項A的 in spite of（儘管）及選項B皆表示仍有去野餐，與原意相反。

questions.stem: The private has a bone fracture.

options.A: The private is brave by nature.
options.B: The private has a bright future.
options.C: The private is under a lot of pressure.
options.D: The private has a break in his bone.

questions.explain:
private: 二等兵
fracture: 骨折、斷裂
break: 骨折處、破裂
解析：題意為「這名二等兵骨折了」。fracture 意為骨折，與 D 選項的 a break in his bone 同義，故答案選D。選項 A 的 nature、B 的 future 與 C 的 pressure，皆為利用與 fracture 尾音相似所設計的聽力押韻陷阱，字義完全不同。

questions.stem: Global warming has negative impacts on the environment.

options.A: Global warming is caused by the environment.
options.B: Global warming is good for the environment.
options.C: Global warming has bad influences on the environment.
options.D: Global warming has reached the point of no return.

questions.explain:
global warming: 全球暖化
negative impact: 負面影響
influence: 影響
解析：題意為全球暖化對環境造成負面影響。negative impacts 與 bad influences 為同義詞代換，故答案選C。干擾選項A顛倒因果關係；B的 good 與原意負面完全相反；D選項提到無法挽回則屬於過度推論。

questions.stem: Leave the paperwork to me.

options.A: Let the paperwork be done at once.
options.B: I won't leave until the paperwork is done.
options.C: Let me take care of the paperwork.
options.D: I hate it when I have to do paperwork.

questions.explain:
leave ... to: 交給…負責
paperwork: 文書工作
take care of: 處理
解析：題意為「把文書工作交給我」。片語 leave ... to sb 表示交由某人負責，與 take care of 同義，故答案選C。干擾項 B 拿 leave「離開」的意思來設字面陷阱；A 偏向要求立刻完成、D 則抱怨討厭文書，均偏離原意。

questions.stem: Low-rise jeans are in fashion now.

options.B: Low-rise jeans are very popular now.
options.C: Low-rise jeans are more affordable now.
options.D: Low-rise jeans are less in demand now.

questions.explain:
in fashion: 流行的、時髦的
outdated: 過時的
in demand: 有需求的
解析：題幹中的 in fashion 意為「流行、時髦」，與 popular 同義，故答案選B。選項A outdated（過時的）與選項D less in demand（需求減少）皆與題意相反，為反義詞陷阱；選項C affordable 指「負擔得起的、價格親民的」，與流行無關。

questions.stem: All the cadets are in the mess hall.
questions.explain:
cadet: 軍校生
mess hall: 軍中餐廳
解析：題意為所有軍校生都在軍用餐廳裡。軍語 mess hall 表示餐廳，在餐廳最合理的活動是用餐，故答案選A。選項B利用 mess 混亂或弄髒的字面意思設下陷阱；選項C聽演講與選項D考試，皆與餐廳的主要功能不符。

questions.stem: It is an all-you-can-eat restaurant.

options.A: The restaurant is open to all people.
options.B: The restaurant is open to members only.
options.D: They serve food listed only on the menu.

questions.explain:
all-you-can-eat: 吃到飽的
unlimited: 無限量的
offer: 提供
解析：題幹表示這是一家「吃到飽」餐廳。all-you-can-eat 意指食物無限量供應，與 C 選項意思相同，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 是利用字面上的 all 設下陷阱，扭曲為對所有人開放；B 與 D 則是自行增添題目未提及的會員與菜單限制。

questions.stem: M: You may order whatever you like to eat. W: I'll have to look at the menu first. Q: Where are they?

turns.t: You may order whatever you like to eat.
I'll have to look at the menu first.
Where are they?

questions.explain:
order: 點餐；點菜
menu: 菜單
解析：男士表示「可以點任何想吃的」，女士回答「要先看菜單」，關鍵字 order 與 menu 明顯指向用餐情境，故答案選C。選項A診所、B博物館、D銀行均非點餐看菜單的場所，純屬地點類別的干擾選項。

questions.stem: W: May I see your boarding pass? M: Here you are. Q: What is the man doing?

turns.t: May I see your boarding pass?
Here you are.
What is the man doing?

questions.explain:
boarding pass: 登機證
get on: 登上（交通工具）
Here you are: 這給你
解析：女士要求看登機證，男士說「這給你」並遞出。出示 boarding pass 代表正準備登機，故答案選A。選項D為字面陷阱，遞交證件並非送禮物（present）；選項B找人、C找出口皆與搭機情境完全無關。

questions.stem: W: Payday is only a few days away. M: Well, I can hardly wait now! Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: He doesn't care about the woman's feelings.
options.C: He wants to lend the woman some money.

turns.t: Payday is only a few days away.
Well, I can hardly wait now!
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
payday: 發薪日
can hardly wait: 迫不及待
badly: 非常、迫切地
解析：女士說發薪日快到了，男士回覆迫不及待，表示他極度缺錢、急需領薪水，答案選D。干擾項B將發薪日過度聯想為休假；C說要借錢給對方與缺錢的語意相反；A提到不在乎女士感受則與對話主題完全無關。

questions.stem: W: I suggest you wear that blue shirt. M: But there is a tear in it. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: There is a hole in the shirt.
options.B: The shirt is not clean enough.
options.C: There is a stain on the shirt.
options.D: The shirt is not his favorite.

turns.t: I suggest you wear that blue shirt.
But there is a tear in it.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
suggest: 建議
tear: 裂口、破洞
stain: 污漬
解析：男士提到襯衫上有個 tear（名詞指裂痕或破洞，非眼淚），表示衣服破了個洞，故答案選A。干擾選項 C 的 stain（污漬）及 B（不乾淨）皆為生活情境的干擾陷阱，與原意不符。

questions.stem: M: Is it OK to have spaghetti for dinner? W: Well, I'm easy about food. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.B: She doesn't like spaghetti at all.
options.C: She thinks cooking spaghetti is easy.
options.D: She is not particular about food.

turns.t: Is it OK to have spaghetti for dinner?
Well, I'm easy about food.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
spaghetti: 義大利麵
be easy about: 隨和、不挑剔
be particular about: 對...講究、挑剔
解析：男士問晚餐吃義大利麵好嗎，女士回答I'm easy about food，表示自己對吃很隨和、不挑食，因此答案選D。選項C落入easy（容易料理）的字面陷阱；選項A與B則過度推論為非常喜歡或討厭，皆非本意。

questions.stem: W: I'm really tired. I don't want to walk any longer. M: Me, either. Let me hail a cab for us. Q: What is the man going to do?

options.A: Get a taxi from the street.
options.D: Give the woman a free ride.

turns.t: I'm really tired. I don't want to walk any longer.
Me, either. Let me hail a cab for us.
What is the man going to do?

questions.explain:
hail a cab: 招攬計程車
cab: 計程車
解析：男士說「Let me hail a cab」，hail 是在路上招手攔車，cab 即 taxi，因此答案選A。干擾項B是受到女士說很累（tired）的情境誤導；D則是理解陷阱，男方並非自己開車順道載她（give a ride），而是要叫計程車。

questions.stem: M: Why don't you keep a cat as a pet? W: I tend to sneeze when cats are around. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.C: There is no room for pets in her house.
options.D: There is an animal shelter in her area.

turns.t: Why don't you keep a cat as a pet?
I tend to sneeze when cats are around.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
tend to: 往往會、傾向於
sneeze: 打噴嚏
be allergic to: 對…過敏
解析：男士問為何不養貓，女士說貓在身邊時常打噴嚏，代表她對貓過敏，故答案選B。干擾項A提到偏好狗、C說空間不足、D提及收容所，皆未在對話中出現，為憑空捏造的選項陷阱。

questions.stem: W: I've been coughing for three days. M: Don't worry. I'll give you a prescription after an examination. Q: Who is the man?

turns.t: I've been coughing for three days.
Don't worry. I'll give you a prescription after an examination.
Who is the man?

questions.explain:
cough: 咳嗽
prescription: 處方箋、藥方
examination: 身體檢查、診察
解析：女子表示已咳嗽三天，男子說檢查後會開處方箋給她。由關鍵字 examination 與 prescription 可推知男子身分為醫生，故答案選C。干擾選項A老師容易因 examination（亦有考試之意）產生字面陷阱，但老師無法開藥方；B經理與D店員則完全脫離看診情境。

questions.stem: M: Why have you become a vegetarian? Is it because of your religion? W: No, I avoid eating meat or fish because it is good for the Earth. Q: Why has the woman become a vegetarian?

turns.t: Why have you become a vegetarian? Is it because of your religion?
No, I avoid eating meat or fish because it is good for the Earth.
Why has the woman become a vegetarian?

questions.explain:
vegetarian: 素食者
religion: 宗教
good for the Earth: 對地球有益
解析：男士問女士吃素是否因為宗教，女士回答No否認，並說吃素是good for the Earth（對地球好），也就是環保因素，故答案選B。選項A是男士的猜測且已被女士直接否定，為常見的先入為主字面陷阱；選項C健康與D財務在對話中皆未提及。

questions.stem: M: I'll go get some popcorn. W: Come back soon, Tony. The film is about to begin. Q: Where are they?

turns.t: I'll go get some popcorn.
Come back soon, Tony. The film is about to begin.
Where are they?

questions.explain:
popcorn: 爆米花
film: 電影
be about to: 即將
解析：男士說要買爆米花，女士提醒電影即將開始，問兩人在哪裡。由關鍵字可知場景在電影院，故答案選D。選項A、B美術館與C辦公大樓皆與看電影的情境無關，屬於地點常識的干擾項。

questions.stem: June, the 6th month of the year, is _______ after Juno, the Roman goddess of marriage.
questions.explain:
Be named after…: 以…的名字來命名; related: 有關的; arranged: 被安排的:
informed: 被告知的.

questions.stem: Many unfortunate things have happened to her _______ we separated.
questions.explain: S+have+Vpp (動詞過去分詞) since+S+Ved (動詞過去式). Since: 自從…

questions.stem: Almost all of my friends had joined a fitness center before I _______.
questions.explain: 考時態, 根據…had joined…, 故選did = joined.

questions.stem: Recently there _______ much unrest in a few countries around the world.
questions.explain: S (主詞): unrest: 為uncountable noun (不可數名詞), 故選there is ...

questions.stem: _______ corn is usually believed to be a food source, much of it is now used to make biofuel.
Living plant cells produce amino acids, _______ are the chief components of proteins.
questions.explain: Which引導形容詞子句, 補充說明前句.

questions.stem: Morris was _______ on a beach chair and taking a sunbath.
questions.explain:
根據題意, 選lying. lie:（人，動物）躺，臥, lie-lay-lain, lie-lying; lay = put:
放，擱, lay-laid-laid, lay-laying; let: 允許，讓; link: 連結.

questions.stem: Nowadays, not only woman _______ men are willing to receive cosmetic surgery.
questions.explain: Not only…but also…: 不僅…也是…

questions.stem: _______ Tanya is interested in going backpacking comes as no surprise to us.
questions.explain: that引導的noun子句作為主詞: 視為第三人稱單數.

questions.stem: The Nineteenth Amendment to the Constitution, which gives women the right to vote, was not ratified_______ 1920.
questions.explain: not... until...: 直到...才...

questions.stem: Professor Davis took a position at the University of Montana, _______ he taught for 10 years.
questions.explain:
補充說明, 先行詞University of Montana是地點, 故選關係代名詞where, 也可
改寫成: Professor Davis took..., which he taught in for 10 years.

questions.stem: Just _______ you and me, bungee jumping is a sport for someone else.
questions.explain: Between…and…: 【口】嚴格保密

questions.stem: Rushing to catch the bus, Mike fell and sprained his _______.
questions.explain:
sprain one’s ankle: 踝關節扭傷; saddle: 鞍，馬鞍; pedal: 踏板；腳蹬; medal:
獎章, 勛章

questions.stem: It's a _______ that you cannot make it to the dinner party tonight.
questions.explain:
It is a shame that… = It’s a great disappointment that…: 真可惜…; shake: 搖
晃, 震動, 抖動; shade: 蔭, 陰涼處; share: 分享.

questions.stem: If I _______ you, I would read the instructions before putting that bicycle together.
questions.explain: If S+Ved, S+would/should/could/might+Vr…: 與現在事實相反假設語態句型.

questions.stem: The defense witness contradicted himself several times _______.
questions.explain:
根據The defense witness contradicted (否認) himself…題意,選 in court: 法
院; on schedule : 按照預定時間; for free: 免費的; at best: 至多, 最高（多）可
能.

questions.stem: By comparing prices carefully, Bill eventually bought the car he wanted _______ a reasonable price.
questions.explain: At a reasonable price: 以合理價格

questions.stem: Twelve gallons is all_______ this gas tank will hold.
questions.explain: what = the thing that

questions.stem: _______ the legendary gods of old, today's superheroes in the movies have magical powers.
questions.explain: 根據題意, 選 ‘like’: prep (介係詞): 像，如.

questions.stem: The dog as well as the puppies _______ excited by the knock on the door.
questions.explain: A+as well as+B… = A and B: A和B; 動詞的選擇根據A, 故選was.

questions.stem: I did not go abroad with them, the reason _______ that I wanted to work at home.
questions.explain:
…, the reason…: 分詞片語或分詞構句, 可改寫成adv子句: I did not...,
because the reason was that...

questions.stem: _______ the physical therapy, the soldier was able to walk again.
questions.explain:
thanks to + n/Ving… = due to…: 意思是那個人或物是引起事情發生的原因;
but for…: 要不是...

questions.stem: You must admit that it was your choice, not _______.
questions.explain: mine = my choice

questions.stem: Colonel Wilson has received _______ awards for service and leadership.
questions.explain:
Numerous = many: 許多的; cautious = careful: 留心的, 注意的; dangerous:
危險的; serious: 一系列的.

questions.stem: Not having drunk vodka before, Harvey was _______ surprised at its strength.
questions.explain:
Somewhat: 有點，稍微; sometimes: 有時; ever: (多用於疑問句，否定句和表
示條件和比較的附屬子句, 在任何時候, 從來,至今; even: 甚至, 連.

questions.stem: You'll look much younger if you have your beard _______.
questions.explain: Have+n+Vpp (被動): 讓…被處置, 故選shaved.

questions.stem: My brother, _______ is two years older than me, teaches at the University of Texas.
questions.explain:
Who: relative pronoun (關係代名詞), 因先行詞是人- my brother, 故選who, 引
導形容詞子句, 說明S: my brother.

questions.stem: The train inched along, gaining speed only after it had left the city _______.
questions.explain:
根據題意, 選behind, behind (adv): 在背後,（遺留）在後; along…: 沿著…;

Slide home: 滑至本壘; homely: 家庭的, 家常的; house: 房子, 住宅; housing:

questions.stem: After the earthquake, the _______ glass was scattered all over the floor.
questions.explain: Vpp (動詞過去分詞), 當adj, 有被動之意; broken: 被打破的.

questions.stem: In West Africa, the Guinean Rainforest is rapidly disappearing. A new study says increased production of coca, cassava and oil palm has meant more land is being cleared for agriculture. But West Africa's success in feeding itself has come at a terrible price. What may the "terrible price" refer to?
questions.explain:
disappear: 消失
agriculture: 農業
at a terrible price: 付出慘痛代價
解析：短文指出西非因擴大農作導致幾內亞雨林迅速消失，成功自足的「慘痛代價」即指雨林流失，故答案選C。干擾項A為字面陷阱，將代價誤解為糧食價格飆漲；B文中完全未提及；D是發展過程而非所承受的負面代價。

questions.stem: Betty and Robert are trying to find success in the city of their dreams. Like a lot of young people, they moved to Los Angeles to pursue film and TV careers. They are working hard to make their dreams come true before they plan to get married. What are they pursuing?
questions.explain:
pursue: 追求
career: 職業、事業
show business: 演藝圈、娛樂產業
解析：題目詢問兩人正在追求什麼。文中提到他們前往洛杉磯是為了 pursue film and TV careers（追求影視事業），即演藝圈，因此答案選A。選項B美滿婚姻是夢想實現後的下一步計畫，非目前追求的目標；選項C心靈平靜與選項D無法實現的目標在文中皆未提及，為字面無關干擾項。

questions.stem: Nature has provided a variety of creatures with the ability to produce their own light called bioluminescence. The light is released by a chemical reaction involving some enzymes of the organisms. This sort of light, which gives off almost not heat, is different from that of the sun. According to the passage, bioluminescence is _______.
questions.explain:
bioluminescence: 生物發光
give off: 散發、發出
chemical reaction: 化學反應
解析：題意詢問生物發光的特性。文中明確指出這種光「gives off almost no heat（幾乎不散發熱量）」，與太陽不同，因此屬於冷光，故答案選A。干擾項B（強光）、C（交通號誌燈）及D（警示燈）皆為常識字面的干擾選項，文章完全未提及。

questions.stem: Studies have shown that dogs can be powerful motivators to get people moving. One study even found that older people are more likely to take regular walks if the walking companion is canine rather than human. Eventually, walking is good for both ends of the leash. What does the last sentence mean?

options.A: Both slow walking and brisk walking are good.
options.B: Walking is good for dogs and their owners.
options.C: Both dogs and cats are good companions.
options.D: Walking is good for both young and old people.

questions.explain:
motivator: 激勵因素
canine: 犬類的、狗
leash: 狗鍊、牽繩
解析：句中「牽繩的兩端」一端是狗、一端是牽狗的主人，意指散步對狗和主人雙方皆有益，故答案選B。選項A的快走慢走、C的貓咪及D的老幼對比，皆未掌握牽繩借指人犬的隱喻，屬於過度延伸或無關的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Meat is murder? Well, perhaps not for much longer. A pioneering group of scientists are now working to grow real meat in the laboratory using cells from live pigs or chickens. Such meat, they claim, is not only good for animal welfare but healthier for people and the planet. According to the passage, the meat produced in the lab is _______.
questions.explain:
pioneering: 先驅的
welfare: 福利
environmentally-friendly: 環保的
解析：短文提到實驗室培育肉對地球更健康（healthier for the planet），意即對環境友善，故答案選D。選項A（價格便宜）與B（素食者食用）文中皆未提及；選項C（減少謀殺案）則是將開頭比喻宰殺動物的說法誤作字面意思的陷阱。
